A great many songs are one loop of four chords, played round and round while the melody, the words and
the arrangement change on top. The loops are not very different from each other: they are the same
handful of chords (I, ii, IV, V, vi, and a few borrowed from the minor) in a different order, or with
one of them swapped. This lesson goes through the loops one at a time. Each has the chords, the same
four bars on a grand staff (block chords in the treble, the bass note below) and the site's backing
band, which plays it round and round so that you hear it as a loop.

**How to use the page.** Press ▶ on any chart and the band plays four times round after a one-bar
count-in. The bar that is sounding lights up, on the chart and on the staff. Under every chord is its
Roman numeral, which stays the same in every key: **C G Am F** in the key of C is the same loop as
**D A Bm G** in the key of D. The strip at the bottom of the window sets the key, the feel, the tempo
and the chord instrument, and you can change them while the band plays. The shaded bars are the ones
that differ from the first loop.

## 1. The axis loop: I V vi IV

**C, G, Am, F.** The loop that is under *Let It Be*, *No Woman, No Cry* and the verse of *Don't Stop
Believin'*, among a great many others. The bass drops from C to G, rises a step to A and falls a third to F. Three major
chords and one minor: the minor chord keeps it from sounding simply happy.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="axis"></div>

Play it until you can hum the bass note of each bar. Every other loop is compared with this one.

## 2. The same chords, started later: vi IV I V

**Am, F, C, G.** The four chords are the same; the loop starts on the minor chord, so that it sounds
like a minor song, and the major chord C arrives in the middle. *Zombie* by the Cranberries is this
loop (in E minor), and so is the chorus of *Despacito*.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="rot"></div>

Compare the two charts: there is no new chord. Where a loop starts is what the ear takes for home.
The other two starting points are **IV I V vi** (F, C, G, Am) and **V vi IV I** (G, Am, F, C).

## 3. The fifties loop: I vi IV V

**C, Am, F, G.** The doo-wop loop. It has the chords
of the axis loop, but with the minor chord second, so the bass steps down by thirds: C, A, F, and then
the G climbs to C again. *Stand by Me* is built on it. Listen to bar 4: the V chord is the last bar
and it leads straight back to C.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="fifties"></div>

## 4. The turnaround: I vi ii V

**C, Am, Dm, G.** Replace the IV with its relative minor, **ii**. The bass now moves round the
circle of fifths: C, A, D, G, and back to C. This is the *turnaround* of jazz, and the A section of
Gershwin's *I Got Rhythm* (the "rhythm changes") begins this way. Put a seventh on each chord and it
is the sound of a standard.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="turn"></div>

Bar 3 is the only difference from the fifties loop. The ii chord and the IV chord share two of their
three notes (F and A), so one can stand in for the other.

## 5. Out and back: I IV V IV

**C, F, G, F.** The loop of *Louie Louie* and *Wild Thing*. There is no minor chord and no change of
direction; the loop goes up to the dominant and back down by the same step. Because the bar-4 chord
is IV, not I, it does not feel finished, and the loop goes round again and again.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="out"></div>

## 6. Borrowing a chord: I ♭VII IV I

**C, B♭, F, C.** B♭ is not in the key of C. It is the chord on the flat seventh, borrowed from the
mixolydian mode (a major scale with a flat seventh) and the note that the blues calls the flat seven.
*Sweet Home Alabama* goes I, ♭VII, IV this way. In C the bass goes down a step, then down a fourth, then
down a fourth again.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="flat7"></div>

## 7. The minor loops

Two loops in the minor, written here in C minor (three flats in the signature).

- **i ♭VII ♭VI V**: **Cm, B♭, A♭, G.** The *Andalusian* loop. The bass falls by step, C, B♭, A♭, G, and
  the last chord is a major V, with the leading tone B, so that it pulls hard back to Cm. *Hit the
  Road Jack* is this loop.
- **i ♭VI ♭III ♭VII**: **Cm, A♭, E♭, B♭.** The four chords of the axis loop in E♭ major, started on
  the vi chord: loop 2 in its minor key. It is the sound of much current pop.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="andal"></div>
<div class="bl-step" data-step="minor4"></div>

Play the two minor loops and then loop 2. The notes are different, but the shape, down by steps then up
by a third, is the same.

## Build your own loop

Choose a chord for each bar, or start from one of the loops above, and the chart and the staff rewrite
themselves. Change a menu while the band is playing and the new chords come in at the next bar. The
numeral next to each chord is its place in the key of C.

<div id="bl-builder" class="bl-widget"></div>

## Test your ear

The band plays one of the loops. Pick the one you heard. If you are not sure, listen for the bass
first: does it fall, climb or leap?

<div id="bl-quiz" class="bl-widget"></div>

## Where to go next

- Play along. Set the strip at the bottom to **Loop**, pick a key and play or sing a melody over each
  loop in turn. Start with just the chord roots.
- Take a loop you built to **Tools → Backing Track** (use *Copy as ABC* above and paste it into
  *Edit the changes (ABC)* there) to choose the bass line, comping rhythm and drum groove.
- Try the moves of [the lesson on C, Am, F, G](pop-changes.qmd) (extensions, passing chords, secondary
  dominants, two-fives) on any of these loops.

```{=html}
<script>
// The four-chord loops lesson: every chart on the page is drawn by TuneChart and played by the Backing Track band
// (BandPlayer with a BandCatalog style). Charts are written in C ("A B" = two chords in a bar, "A:2 B C" = A for
// two beats, then B and C for one each) and transposed, on the page and in the band, to the key chosen in the strip.
(function () {
  var cat = window.BandCatalog, H = window.BandHarmony;
  if (!cat || !H || !window.BandPlayer || !window.TuneChart) return;
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function el(tag, cls, text) { var e = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) e.className = cls; if (text != null) e.textContent = text; return e; }

  // `vs` = the loop a step is compared with (its shaded bars, and the button that plays it); `minor` = written with the key signature of C minor
  var STEPS = {
    axis:    { bars: 'C|G|Am|F' },
    rot:     { bars: 'Am|F|C|G', vs: 'axis' },
    fifties: { bars: 'C|Am|F|G', vs: 'axis' },
    turn:    { bars: 'C|Am|Dm|G', vs: 'fifties' },
    out:     { bars: 'C|F|G|F', vs: 'axis' },
    flat7:   { bars: 'C|Bb|F|C', vs: 'axis' },
    andal:   { bars: 'Cm|Bb|Ab|G', vs: 'axis', minor: true },
    minor4:  { bars: 'Cm|Ab|Eb|Bb', vs: 'axis', minor: true }
  };
  // the loops, for the ear test and the builder's presets: [name as numerals, bars]
  var LOOPS = [['I V vi IV', 'C|G|Am|F'], ['vi IV I V', 'Am|F|C|G'], ['I vi IV V', 'C|Am|F|G'], ['I vi ii V', 'C|Am|Dm|G'], ['I IV V IV', 'C|F|G|F'], ['I ♭VII IV I', 'C|Bb|F|C'],
    ['i ♭VII ♭VI V', 'Cm|Bb|Ab|G'], ['i ♭VI ♭III ♭VII', 'Cm|Ab|Eb|Bb']];
  // the builder: one chord for each bar, from these
  var CHORDS = ['C', 'Dm', 'Em', 'F', 'G', 'G7', 'Am', 'Bb', 'Ab', 'Eb', 'Cm', 'Fm'];
  var SLOTS = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(function (k) { return { from: k, opts: CHORDS.map(function (c) { return [c, c]; }) }; });
  var FEELS = [{ id: 'pop', label: 'Piano ballad', tempo: 76 }, { id: 'strum', label: 'Acoustic strum', tempo: 100 }, { id: 'motown', label: 'Motown / soul', tempo: 110 }, { id: 'swing', label: 'Medium swing', tempo: 120 }];
  var KEYS = ['C', 'D♭', 'D', 'E♭', 'E', 'F', 'G♭', 'G', 'A♭', 'A', 'B♭', 'B'], SHARP = { 2: 1, 4: 1, 7: 1, 9: 1, 11: 1 };
  var state = { key: 0, feel: 'pop', tempo: 76, inst: 'piano', loop: false };

  function split(s) { return s.split('|'); }
  // one bar: chords separated by spaces, "C:2" = two beats; chords without a length share what is left
  function barAbc(b) {
    var cs = b.split(' '), fixed = 0, free = 0;
    cs.forEach(function (c) { var m = /:(\d)$/.exec(c); if (m) fixed += +m[1]; else free++; });
    var each = free ? (4 - fixed) / free : 0;
    return cs.map(function (c) { var m = /^(.*):(\d)$/.exec(c), n = m ? +m[2] : each; return '"' + (m ? m[1] : c) + '"z' + n; }).join(' ');
  }
  function plain(c) { return c.replace(/:\d$/, ''); }
  function abcOf(bars) { return 'X:1\nT:Changes\nM:4/4\nL:1/4\nK:C\n' + bars.map(barAbc).join(' | ') + ' |]'; }
  function numerals(bars) { return bars.map(function (b) { return b.split(' ').map(function (c) { return H.roman(plain(c), 0); }).join(' '); }).join(' | '); }
  function semis() { var d = state.key; return d > 6 ? d - 12 : d; }
  function band() {
    var so = cat.styleOpts(state.feel, state.inst === 'guitar' ? 'guitar' : 'piano'), opts = Object.assign({}, so.opts, { variation: 0.5 }), need = so.instruments.slice();
    if (state.inst === 'organ') { opts.compSound = 'hammond'; need[1] = 'hammond'; }
    return { opts: opts, instruments: need };
  }

  // ---- a chart that follows the key and shades some of its bars ----
  var charts = [];
  function makeChart(host, bars, marked, minor) {
    var c = { bars: bars, marked: marked || [], minor: !!minor }, inner = el('div'), sh = el('div', 'bl-staff'); host.appendChild(inner); host.appendChild(sh);
    c.staff = window.LessonChordStaff ? LessonChordStaff.create(sh, { bars: bars, tonic: 0, minor: !!minor, transpose: semis(), flats: !SHARP[state.key] }) : null;
    c.chart = TuneChart.render(inner, abcOf(bars), { header: false, barsPerRow: 4, roman: 'both', romanFn: H.roman, transpose: semis(), preferFlats: !SHARP[state.key] });
    c.mark = function () { c.chart.barEls.forEach(function (b, i) { b.classList.toggle('bl-new', c.marked.indexOf(i) >= 0); }); };
    c.set = function (bars, marked) { c.bars = bars; c.marked = marked || []; c.chart.setTune(abcOf(bars)); c.mark(); if (c.staff) c.staff.set(bars); };
    c.setLive = function (i) { c.chart.setLive(i); if (c.staff) c.staff.light(i); };
    c.rekey = function () { c.chart.setTranspose(semis(), !SHARP[state.key]); c.mark(); if (c.staff) c.staff.rekey(semis(), !SHARP[state.key]); };
    c.mark(); charts.push(c); return c;
  }

  // ---- one band for the page ----
  var player = null, now = null;                               // now = { btn, label, view } of what is playing
  function status(t) { $('bl-status').textContent = t || ''; }
  function idle() {
    if (now) { now.btn.textContent = now.label; now.btn.classList.remove('bl-on'); if (now.view) now.view.setLive(-1); now = null; }
    $('bl-stop').disabled = true; status('');
  }
  function stop() { if (player) { try { player.stop(); } catch (e) {} } idle(); }
  function play(btn, view, bars) {
    var same = now && now.btn === btn; stop(); if (same) return;
    var parsed = TuneChart.parse(abcOf(bars)), b = band();
    if (!player) player = window.BandPlayer.create({ parsed: parsed, tempo: state.tempo, transpose: semis(), countIn: 1, opts: b.opts, instruments: b.instruments,
      onBar: function (info) { if (!now) return; status(info.countIn ? 'Count-in' : info.ending ? '' : 'Bar ' + (info.index + 1) + (state.loop ? '' : ', time ' + (info.chorus + 1) + ' of 4'));
        if (now.view) now.view.setLive(info.countIn || info.ending ? -1 : info.index); },
      onState: function (s) { if (s === 'loading') status('Loading the sounds…'); },
      onEnd: idle });
    else { player.setInstruments(b.instruments); player.setChart(parsed); player.setOpts(b.opts); player.setTempo(state.tempo); player.setTranspose(semis()); }
    player.setCycle(null, null); player.setStartBar(0);
    player.setChoruses(state.loop ? 0 : 4);
    now = { btn: btn, label: btn.textContent, view: view, bars: bars };
    btn.textContent = '■ Stop'; btn.classList.add('bl-on'); $('bl-stop').disabled = false;
    player.play().then(null, function () { idle(); status('The sounds could not be loaded.'); });
  }
  function playBtn(label, primary) { var b = el('button', 'btn btn-sm ' + (primary ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline-secondary'), label); b.type = 'button'; return b; }

  // ---- the numbered sections ----
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.bl-step'), function (host) {
    var s = STEPS[host.getAttribute('data-step')]; if (!s) return;
    var bars = split(s.bars), before = s.vs ? split(STEPS[s.vs].bars) : null;
    var changed = before ? bars.map(function (b, i) { return b !== before[i] ? i : -1; }).filter(function (i) { return i >= 0; }) : [];
    host.classList.add('bl-widget');
    var tools = el('div', 'bl-tools'), paper = el('div'); host.appendChild(tools); host.appendChild(paper);
    var view = makeChart(paper, bars, changed, s.minor);
    var b1 = playBtn('▶ Play', true); b1.addEventListener('click', function () { play(b1, view, bars); }); tools.appendChild(b1);
    if (before) { var b2 = playBtn('▶ Hear ' + numerals(before).replace(/ \| /g, ' ') + ' for comparison'); b2.addEventListener('click', function () { play(b2, view, before); }); tools.appendChild(b2); }
    if (changed.length) { var lg = el('p', 'bl-legend'); lg.appendChild(el('i')); lg.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Different from ' + numerals(before).replace(/ \| /g, ' '))); host.appendChild(lg); }
  });

  // ---- build your own ----
  function assemble(picks) { var out = []; SLOTS.forEach(function (sl, k) { out.push(sl.opts[picks[k]][1]); }); return out; }
  function optionLabel(o) { return numerals([o[1]]) + '  (' + o[0] + ')'; }
  (function () {
    var host = $('bl-builder'); if (!host) return;
    var picks = [0, 4, 6, 3], grid = el('div', 'bl-slots'), tools = el('div', 'bl-tools'), paper = el('div'), sels = [];
    host.appendChild(grid); host.appendChild(tools); host.appendChild(paper);
    var view = makeChart(paper, assemble(picks), []);
    function marked() { return []; }
    function refresh() {
      view.set(assemble(picks), marked());
      if (now && now.view === view && player) player.setChart(TuneChart.parse(abcOf(view.bars)));
    }
    SLOTS.forEach(function (sl, k) {
      var wrap = el('div'), id = 'bl-slot-' + k, lab = el('label', null, 'Bar ' + (sl.from + 1)), sel = el('select', 'form-select form-select-sm');
      lab.htmlFor = id; sel.id = id;
      sl.opts.forEach(function (o, i) { var op = el('option', null, optionLabel(o)); op.value = i; sel.appendChild(op); });
      sel.value = picks[k]; sel.addEventListener('change', function () { picks[k] = +sel.value; refresh(); });
      wrap.appendChild(lab); wrap.appendChild(sel); grid.appendChild(wrap); sels.push(sel);
    });
    function setAll(fn) { picks = SLOTS.map(fn); sels.forEach(function (s, k) { s.value = picks[k]; }); refresh(); }
    var go = playBtn('▶ Play', true); go.addEventListener('click', function () { play(go, view, view.bars); }); tools.appendChild(go);
    var rnd = playBtn('Surprise me'); rnd.addEventListener('click', function () { setAll(function (sl) { return Math.floor(Math.random() * sl.opts.length); }); }); tools.appendChild(rnd);
    var pre = el('select', 'form-select form-select-sm'); pre.style.width = 'auto'; pre.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Start from a loop');
    var o0 = el('option', null, 'Start from a loop…'); o0.value = ''; pre.appendChild(o0);
    LOOPS.forEach(function (l, i) { var o = el('option', null, l[0]); o.value = i; pre.appendChild(o); });
    pre.addEventListener('change', function () { if (pre.value === '') return; var bs = split(LOOPS[+pre.value][1]); setAll(function (sl, k) { return Math.max(0, CHORDS.indexOf(bs[k])); }); pre.value = ''; }); tools.appendChild(pre);
    var copy = playBtn('Copy as ABC'); tools.appendChild(copy);
    copy.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var text = abcOf(view.bars).replace('T:Changes', 'T:My changes (written in C)');
      var done = function (ok) { copy.textContent = ok ? 'Copied' : 'Could not copy'; setTimeout(function () { copy.textContent = 'Copy as ABC'; }, 1500); };
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { done(true); }, function () { done(false); }); else done(false);
    });
    })();

  // ---- test your ear ----
  (function () {
    var host = $('bl-quiz'); if (!host) return;
    var tools = el('div', 'bl-tools'), ask = el('p', null, 'Press New question to begin.'), count = el('div', 'bl-count'), answers = el('div', 'bl-answers'),
        verdict = el('p', 'bl-verdict'), score = el('p', 'bl-score'), paper = el('div');
    [tools, ask, count, answers, verdict, score, paper].forEach(function (e) { host.appendChild(e); });
    paper.hidden = true; verdict.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    var boxes = []; for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { var d = el('div', null, String(i + 1)); count.appendChild(d); boxes.push(d); }
    var counter = { setLive: function (i) { boxes.forEach(function (b, k) { b.classList.toggle('bl-live', k === i); }); } };
    var q = null, right = 0, asked = 0, last = -1, reveal = null;
    var next = playBtn('New question', true), again = playBtn('▶ Hear it again'); again.disabled = true; tools.appendChild(next); tools.appendChild(again);
    function listen() { if (q) play(again, counter, q.bars); }
    again.addEventListener('click', listen);
    next.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var k; do { k = Math.floor(Math.random() * LOOPS.length); } while (k === last); last = k;
      var pool = LOOPS.map(function (l, i) { return i; }).filter(function (i) { return i !== k; }).sort(function () { return Math.random() - 0.5; }).slice(0, 3).concat(k).sort(function () { return Math.random() - 0.5; });
      q = { pick: k, bars: split(LOOPS[k][1]), done: false };
      ask.textContent = 'Which loop do you hear?';
      boxes.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('bl-ask'); });
      answers.textContent = ''; verdict.textContent = ''; paper.hidden = true; again.disabled = false;
      pool.forEach(function (i) {
        var b = el('button', 'btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary', LOOPS[i][0]); b.type = 'button'; b.setAttribute('data-loop', i);
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (q.done) return; q.done = true; asked++;
          var ok = i === q.pick; if (ok) right++; else b.classList.add('bl-wrong');
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(answers.children, function (x) { if (+x.getAttribute('data-loop') === q.pick) x.classList.add('bl-right'); });
          verdict.textContent = ok ? 'Yes.' : 'Not this time. The band played ' + LOOPS[q.pick][0] + '.';
          score.textContent = right + ' right out of ' + asked;
          paper.hidden = false;
          var minor = /^Cm/.test(q.bars[0]);
          paper.textContent = ''; reveal = makeChart(paper, q.bars, [], minor);
        });
        answers.appendChild(b);
      });
      if (now && now.btn === again) stop();
      listen();
    });
  })();

  // ---- the strip at the bottom ----
  KEYS.forEach(function (k, i) { var o = el('option', null, k); o.value = i; $('bl-key').appendChild(o); });
  FEELS.forEach(function (f) { var o = el('option', null, f.label); o.value = f.id; $('bl-feel').appendChild(o); });
  function showTempo() { $('bl-tempo').value = state.tempo; $('bl-tempo-n').value = state.tempo; }
  function setTempo(v) { v = Math.max(40, Math.min(220, Math.round(+v) || state.tempo)); state.tempo = v; showTempo(); if (player) player.setTempo(v); }
  function setBand() { if (!player) return; var b = band(); player.setInstruments(b.instruments); player.setOpts(b.opts); }
  $('bl-key').value = state.key; $('bl-feel').value = state.feel; showTempo();
  $('bl-key').addEventListener('change', function () { state.key = +this.value; charts.forEach(function (c) { c.rekey(); }); if (player) player.setTranspose(semis()); });
  $('bl-feel').addEventListener('change', function () { state.feel = this.value; var f = FEELS.filter(function (x) { return x.id === state.feel; })[0]; setBand(); setTempo(f.tempo); });
  $('bl-inst').addEventListener('change', function () { state.inst = this.value; setBand(); });
  $('bl-tempo').addEventListener('input', function () { setTempo(this.value); });
  $('bl-tempo-n').addEventListener('change', function () { setTempo(this.value); });
  $('bl-loop').addEventListener('change', function () { state.loop = this.checked; if (player && now) player.setChoruses(state.loop ? 0 : 4); });
  $('bl-stop').addEventListener('click', stop);
})();
</script>
```
